The generator: place districts by (r, angle) on the hill; lay three radial avenues (S gate -> plaza, E baths -> plaza, W garrison -> plaza) and two ring roads (r=165, r=105); fill each district with its building types by count, footprints snapped to the street grid; run the aqueduct A1-A5; drop 12 cistern grates at the listed points; decorate by habitat rules.

Training loop (streets): Market square -> toolsmiths' street -> garrison gate -> drill yard -> parade stair -> plaza -> bath stairs -> caldarium -> bath stairs down -> market. About 4 min, all on cobbles, past two grates.

Training loop (walls): the whole rampart, 1,500 m, one-way stairs down into the Farms at four points; nothing lives on the wall but barracuda at the gate and cormorants; the great white crosses the north wall.
Blood flow: the aqueduct carries blood downhill at the segment speeds (summit to gate in about 2 minutes); the plaza's blood reaches the market in 75 s and the barracuda at the outfall in 120 s.

Sightlines: streets 10-15 m; the plaza 40 m; the drill yard 25 m; ramparts 60 m+. Alarm regions: Summit (Forum, Chapel, Library), Slopes (Baths, Barracks), Lower (Town, Farms, Gate); the Lost Ones enter at the outer gate and stage at the armory.

Ichor: dead Lost Ones repel sharks and the Wyrm for 60 s within 20 m and draw crabs, cucumbers, and the monitor. A phalanx killed in a street makes that street a safe corridor for a minute and a monitor's dinner for two.
